mustRead: extremely long bare neck with a tiny flat head
fluffy plume wings and tail bustle
why: Strict right-facing lateral walking ostrich: whole head/bill, long bare neck, both long legs and both two-toed feet painted separately with clear margins; white wing plumes and tail fan.
limitations: Long-legged mapping: legKnee is the intertarsal joint; thigh owner is the bare thigh/tibiotarsus below the plumage (C215 ostrich convention).
Far wing is the black upper-back plumage band above the near wing (interpretation, robin convention).
